purpose: Teach: 帆/ニンニク/アダプタ/槍/ゴマ/えび/復刻/仮面ライダー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが帆船の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you that picture book about sailing ships.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Slight smile in the voice. Easy pace, like sharing something she knows will delight him. Soft openness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママのニンニクパスタ大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Mom's garlic pasta!
lines.style: Bright, earnest declaration. Quick tempo, genuine enthusiasm without performance. The joy of sharing something simple that matters to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスマホのアダプタを買ってきたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad brought home a phone adapter.
lines.style: Gentle, observational. A small, matter-of-fact tone. Like mentioning something she's noticed he might find useful. Understated warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、博物館で槍を見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a spear at the museum!
lines.style: Excited, vivid. Quick-paced, like the image is still fresh in his mind. Eager to share the small wonder of it with her. Unfiltered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、おやつのお団子にゴマがついてるわね
lines.en: Sho, there's sesame stuck to your dango.
lines.style: Soft, affectionate observation. Almost a gentle tease. Close, like she's noticing something only someone who cares would catch. Tender amusement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お寿司のえびが一番好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like the shrimp in sushi best!
lines.style: Straightforward conviction. Clear, uncomplicated preference stated with small-boy certainty. Quick, direct, not seeking approval—just sharing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔の絵本を復刻して買って来たわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad found a vintage picture book and bought it for you.
lines.style: Quiet delight in her voice. A small discovery she's passing on. Measured pace, like she's handing him something precious. Tender attentiveness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、仮面ライダーになりたい!
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to be Kamen Rider!
lines.style: Pure, unguarded declaration. Bright, immediate, no doubt in it. The unshakeable certainty of a six-year-old's dream. Direct eye contact in the voice.
